title: Host Dropout Alert v1
description: Every 15 minutes: detect OneAgent hosts that were active in the prior day but silent for ~1h, and open/keep-alive detailed CUSTOM_ALERT Problems. Stops keep-alives when reporting resumes.

detect_and_alert.name: detect_and_alert
detect_and_alert.description: Find 1h silent hosts and ingest CUSTOM_ALERT keep-alives (or CUSTOM_INFO on restore).
